def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform marker stripe determines the axis; place an 8-line
    # immediately beyond the colored shape, away from that stripe.
    stripe_color = grid[0][0]
    if all(row[0] == stripe_color for row in grid):
        color = next(c for row in grid for c in row if c not in (stripe_color, next(x for x in row if x != stripe_color)))
    # identify background from the most frequent color, stripe by a full edge
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    stripe_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg), None)
    stripe_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg), None)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if stripe_col is not None:
        scol = grid[0][stripe_col]
        obj = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, scol)]
        cmin = min(c for r,c in obj)
        # Move the object next to the stripe, with a full 8 separator column.
        shift = cmin - 1
        # Erase the original object, then place it beside the marker stripe.
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c-shift] = grid[r][c]
        mark = max(c-shift for r,c in obj) + 1
        if mark < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][mark] = 8
    elif stripe_row is not None:
        obj = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, grid[stripe_row][0])]
        rmin = min(r for r,c in obj)
        for r,c in obj: out[r-1][c] = grid[r][c]
        mark = rmin - 1
        if mark >= 0: out[mark] = [8]*w
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform marker stripe determines the axis; place an 8-line
    # immediately beyond the colored shape, away from that stripe.
    stripe_color = grid[0][0]
    if all(row[0] == stripe_color for row in grid):
        color = next(c for row in grid for c in row if c not in (stripe_color, next(x for x in row if x != stripe_color)))
    # identify background from the most frequent color, stripe by a full edge
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    stripe_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg and sum(v == grid[r][0] for row in grid for v in row) == w and any(grid[rr][cc] not in (bg, grid[r][0]) for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w))), None)
    stripe_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg), None)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if stripe_col is not None and stripe_row is not None:
        obj = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, grid[stripe_row][0])]
        rmax = max(r for r,c in obj)
        if rmax + 1 < h: out[rmax+1] = [8]*w
        out[stripe_row] = grid[stripe_row][:]
        # Restore color-2 stripe when it overlaps the inferred uniform row.
        for rr in range(h):
            if all(grid[k][rr] == grid[0][rr] for k in range(h)) and grid[0][rr] != bg:
                for k in range(h): out[k][rr] = grid[k][rr]
    elif stripe_col is not None:
        scol = grid[0][stripe_col]
        obj = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, scol)]
        cmin = min(c for r,c in obj)
        # Move the object next to the stripe, with a full 8 separator column.
        shift = cmin - 1
        # Erase the original object, then place it beside the marker stripe.
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c-shift] = grid[r][c]
        mark = max(c-shift for r,c in obj) + 1
        if mark < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][mark] = 8
    elif stripe_row is not None:
        obj = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, grid[stripe_row][0])]
        rmin = min(r for r,c in obj)
        for r,c in obj: out[r-1][c] = grid[r][c]
        mark = rmin - 1
        if mark >= 0: out[mark] = [8]*w
    return out
